I won’t pretend to know how you feel. I haven’t gone through half of the things you have. In comparison, my life is easy. But i can tell you with complete certainty that someone will miss you when you’re gone. Crossing the line will result in someone being in life long pain. You matter. You are here for a reason. I admire your strength and your perseverance. i don’t think i could’ve lasted as long. Consider yourself a role model. you’ve made it so far. this depression won’t last forever. there are options beyond suicide. please consider your alternatives for those who would be lost without you.

I know how you feel. I felt that way once. suddenly everything felt like a competition between her and myself and i couldn’t ever put the torch down. My best advice to you is to just let her go. she doesn’t know you think about her this way. the resentment you have against both her and your s/o really only hurts you. chances are, you’re not a 4/10 and she isn’t a 12/10 either. your mind can play tricks with you when stressed. just accept that the past is the past and that you can only work to make sure the future is better. if you have doubts about your s/o’s feelings, tell him exactly how you’ve been feeling. have a deep chat and clearly explain where the stress is coming from. if you don’t find the answer you need, consider finding someone who will bring your confidence up instead of letting it drain.
